# A project's own build script: writes the module the project imports as
# `generated`, and defines the build option `app_TIMES`.

import [File, Path] from io;
import os;

main(): int {
    var out = Path(os.environment("PEP_OUT_DIR").value());
    var text = "export greeting(): String {\n    return \"hello\";\n}\n";
    if (File.write_text(out.join(Path("module.pep")), text).is_err()) {
        return 1;
    }
    print("pep:build-option=TIMES=7");
    return 0;
}
